This non-statutory guidance is for:

school leaders

school staff

employers, including:

local authorities

governing bodies

academy trusts

The guidance provides clarity for employers on their legal duties to prevent and address intimidation, harassment and bullying of school staff. It sets out the actions schools should take to make sure all staff are:

supported

respected

protected
